verdict.rationale: Plausible documents HTTP APIs, including the Stats API's /api/v2/query endpoint and the Events API. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. Human-readable API docs are adjacent to this story and do not count as a machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
